create_scheduler: create a Scheduler instance with a Config object to manage sequence scheduling for speculative decoding
schedule_sequences: schedule waiting and running sequences for prefill and decode phases with block allocation checks
preempt_sequences: preempt running sequences by deallocating their KV cache blocks and moving them back to the waiting queue
postprocess_sequences: postprocess scheduled sequences by appending generated tokens and updating KV cache block hashes
postprocess_speculate: postprocess speculative decoding results by rolling back KV caches, updating metadata, and handling EAGLE activations
